author: Keystone Today
title: PPL Corporation announces quarterly dividend for July 2026
text:
PPL Corporation announced on May 13 that it will pay a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.2850 per share, with the payment scheduled for July 1, 2026. Shareowners of record as of June 10, 2026 will be eligible to receive the dividend.
The announcement is significant for shareholders who rely on regular dividends as part of their investment strategy. The company’s decision to declare this dividend reflects its ongoing commitment to providing value to its investors.
PPL Corporation is headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania and operates as a U.S. energy company serving more than 3.6 million customers with electricity and natural gas. The company said it focuses on delivering these services safely, reliably and affordably while building smarter and more resilient power grids and advancing sustainable energy solutions.
Investors or members of the media seeking additional information are encouraged to visit PPL’s official website at www.pplweb.com or access further news updates at www.pplnewsroom.com .
The next steps include monitoring upcoming financial reports from PPL Corporation as well as future announcements regarding dividends or corporate developments.
